name: The Master’s Cistern
tagline: The dead want their road back. The grove wants it buried.
description: The Thornward Circle has closed the road to a lich’s cistern. His undead steward Mira must recover the occupied tollhouse chest and keep the estate from disappearing beneath Vael’s roots.
shortDescription: Command Mira’s skeletal levy in a three-chapter struggle over a crypt road and its waterworks.

ending.text: Leave the grave-soil by the grove alone. We have a passage under the ridge now, and I will not spend another levy defending our master’s stubbornness.
